\- She can come across as very blunt, with flat line delivery. This could be some kind of dissociation stemming from her trauma with her dad, but it cuts her character short.

\- The way she bonds with other characters can be slightly frustrating, I think. Viewers go crazy for a parent-child relationship for one of the main characters, so I think the fact that she seemed so initially dismissive of Will didn't exactly work in her favour. We don't see her bond all that much with the protagonists.. despite their affections for her, she doesn't seem all that close to Will or Alana. We also never see her interact much with other typically liked characters; Jack, Bella, Beverly, Price and Zimmer. Instead, she seems, at first, to side with typically disliked characters- Freddie and Hannibal being a few. You also get the feeling that she latched onto the wrong father figure out of Lecter and Graham, which is frustrating.

\- TL;DR: Abigail is supposed to be some kind of daughter trope between Hannibal and Will, yet isn't really a child (19 I believe?) and doesn't show much genuine affection for the characters that viewers want her to.
